posts.zh:
dsh-desktop-tray 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0054841d01f4cec368e8.html
posts.en:
dsh-desktop-tray is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0054841d01f4cec368e8.html
